chunks: From him, from Fudayla, from Aban, from Muhammad, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said:
In silver with silver, weight for weight, and in gold with gold, weight for weight.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for exchanging gold for silver in Islamic jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) specifies the 'thaman bi thaman' rule for gold and silver, mandating equal weight and immediate hand-to-hand exchange to prevent riba. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as the foundational evidence for distinguishing between same-species currency exchanges (which require weight equality) and mixed-species exchanges (which allow for value-based differences).
